_help: Edit this file and commit it to main. GitHub reads it every 5 minutes. mode check asks Gemini to review every blog on the content page. mode publish writes new posts. frequency: interval (every intervalMinutes), daily (every day at time), weekly (on days at time), dates (each YYYY-MM-DD in dates, at time), once (at runAt). time is HH:mm in timezone. days are monday through sunday. postsPerRun and gapMinutes apply only when mode is publish. maxRuns stops after that many successful runs; use null for no limit. This test checks all blog content once. Reset runCount to 0 in content/blog-schedule-state.json to run it again.
